jobs.name: butcher-forge-exploration
jobs.prompt: A concept artist sketchbook page of prop exploration for a dark fantasy video game: twelve rough concept sketches of the work station of a towering alien weapon smith, a cold forge and a surgeon bench where weapons go in and come out changed, laid out in a grid of four columns and three rows on white paper, each sketch numbered with a big hand written number from 1 to 12. Loose confident pencil lines with grey marker shading and a quick wash of dark gunmetal, orange glyph light, and three accent glows: purple, electric blue and gold. Every sketch shows the whole object in a three quarter view standing on bare sand, each a genuinely different idea, all made by one alien civilisation from pearly opalescent scaled shell, plum cloth printed with a starfield, rose gold trims and dark gunmetal with glowing orange glyph seams. Every one shows three lit parts for his three powers: a purple pull like a small black hole, a blue portal, and gold frozen time like a clock. No anvil, no hammer, no fire. The twelve ideas: 1 an operating slab where a weapon lies clamped, three jointed arms above it each ending in a purple, a blue and a gold lens. 2 a standing ring gate a weapon is pushed through, its three segments glowing purple, blue and gold. 3 a captive black hole floating over a rose gold cradle, weapons held into it with long tongs. 4 three stacked basins of light, purple, blue and gold, that a blade is dipped through in turn. 5 a turntable with three stations around it, a weapon riding from one to the next. 6 a tall crucible tower with a purple window, a blue portal mouth at its foot and a gold clock dial on top. 7 an hourglass machine with gold sand falling and a weapon hanging still in its waist. 8 a giant kneeling metal hand that holds a weapon in its palm while three rings orbit it. 9 a loom of light threads strung between two pylons, a weapon woven through the threads. 10 a weapon pinned open like a specimen on a dark board, three glowing scalpels hovering over it. 11 a vertical press with two heavy glyph plates and three orbs above. 12 a dark altar with a swirling vortex in its top, a blue door in its side and a gold clock face on its front. Short hand written notes and arrows beside some sketches. Clean white paper, no frame, no other text.

jobs.name: glutton-bed-exploration
jobs.prompt: A concept artist sketchbook page of prop exploration for a dark fantasy video game: twelve rough concept sketches of the huge bed of an enormous alien that is always asleep, a sleeping throne with his talent tree growing out of it, laid out in a grid of four columns and three rows on white paper, each sketch numbered with a big hand written number from 1 to 12. Loose confident pencil lines with grey marker shading and a quick wash of pearl white with lilac shadows, plum and rose gold, with small glowing fruit. Every sketch shows the whole object in a three quarter view standing on bare sand, each a genuinely different idea, all made by one alien civilisation from pearly opalescent scaled shell, plum cloth printed with a starfield, rose gold trims and dark gunmetal with glowing orange glyph seams. Every one shows a tree of talents growing from the bed, its fruit glowing. Not a bathtub. The twelve ideas: 1 a giant pearly clam shell bed with a rose gold tree growing from its hinge, glowing fruit hanging over the sleeper. 2 a floating crescent moon bed of shell with plum starfield drapes and a tree of light behind it. 3 a mountain of plum starfield cushions with a coral tree growing out of the top. 4 a nest of pearly scales with crystal branches rising from its rim. 5 a low throne bed on four short feet with a bonsai tree of rose gold wire on its headboard. 6 a hovering platform whose tree roots wrap around it and whose fruit hangs over the mouth of the sleeper. 7 a hammock cocoon slung between two branches, the tree itself is the bed frame. 8 a halved giant pearl like an open oyster with a tree of small glowing pearls growing from it. 9 a long chaise of rose gold with the tree drawn in lines of light above it. 10 a bed carried on four floating orbs with a fountain of light branches feeding into it. 11 a bed sunk into a ring of shell plates like petals, the tree rising from the middle. 12 a stack of shell slabs like a layered cake with vines of glyph leaves climbing it. Short hand written notes and arrows beside some sketches. Clean white paper, no frame, no other text.

jobs.name: shade-sigil-exploration
jobs.prompt: A concept artist sketchbook page of prop exploration for a dark fantasy video game: twelve rough concept sketches of a floor circle that a floating alien sorceress hovers over, a rune circle and an astral loom with eight marks for her eight powers, laid out in a grid of four columns and three rows on white paper, each sketch numbered with a big hand written number from 1 to 12. Loose confident pencil lines with grey marker shading and a quick wash of plum, night blue and pale astral violet outlines. Every sketch shows the whole object in a three quarter view standing on bare sand, each a genuinely different idea, all made by one alien civilisation from pearly opalescent scaled shell, plum cloth printed with a starfield, rose gold trims and dark gunmetal with glowing orange glyph seams. Every one is a circle on the ground with eight marks around it. No crystal blades, no loose planks. The twelve ideas: 1 a disc of plum starfield cloth pegged flat on the sand with eight glyphs around its rim. 2 a ring of eight standing stones of dark glass, each with a lit glyph. 3 an orrery of eight small astral spheres orbiting over a floor disc. 4 a loom of eight threads of light running from the centre to eight pegs in a circle. 5 a sundial circle cut into eight segments with a shadow pointer. 6 eight floating mirrors in a ring, all facing in. 7 a mandala of light drawn in the sand with eight petals. 8 a round pool of liquid night sky with eight glyph pads floating on it. 9 a rose gold compass rose inlaid in a dark disc, its eight points each a power. 10 a ring of eight lanterns of astral light standing on thin stems. 11 eight thin concentric rings turning at different speeds just above the ground. 12 a dark disc with an eight armed star of astral ribbons floating over it. Short hand written notes and arrows beside some sketches. Clean white paper, no frame, no other text.

jobs.name: whisperer-pod-exploration
jobs.prompt: A concept artist sketchbook page of prop exploration for a dark fantasy video game: twelve rough concept sketches of the pod of an alien who upgrades fighters, where a fighter steps in plain and steps out wearing new regalia, laid out in a grid of four columns and three rows on white paper, each sketch numbered with a big hand written number from 1 to 12. Loose confident pencil lines with grey marker shading and a quick wash of pearl white with lilac shadows, rose gold and plum. Every sketch shows the whole object in a three quarter view standing on bare sand, each a genuinely different idea, all made by one alien civilisation from pearly opalescent scaled shell, plum cloth printed with a starfield, rose gold trims and dark gunmetal with glowing orange glyph seams. Every one shows the moment of change, a plain figure going in or a crowned figure coming out. No flat window. The twelve ideas: 1 an upright pearly egg that opens like petals around a figure wrapped in light. 2 a rose gold archway, a plain figure walking in one side and a crowned one out the other. 3 a chrysalis hanging from a rose gold hook with a figure curled inside. 4 a tall standing mirror of liquid pearl that a figure steps into. 5 a plinth with pieces of regalia, a crown, shoulder plates and a cloak, orbiting above it. 6 an upright shell sarcophagus with a window of plum starfield cloth. 7 a mannequin frame of rose gold wire with cloth weaving itself around it. 8 a bud of shell petals on a stem opening to show the finished figure. 9 a basin of pearl liquid that a figure rises out of. 10 a cage of curved shell ribs closing around a figure like a corset. 11 a vertical loom weaving regalia onto a body of light. 12 a spiral nautilus shell that a figure walks into and comes out of changed. Short hand written notes and arrows beside some sketches. Clean white paper, no frame, no other text.

jobs.name: supply-cases-exploration
jobs.prompt: A concept artist sketchbook page of prop exploration for a dark fantasy video game: twelve rough concept sketches of the luggage of five alien exiles, a folded armoury of travel cases that pulse with glyph light, laid out in a grid of four columns and three rows on white paper, each sketch numbered with a big hand written number from 1 to 12. Loose confident pencil lines with grey marker shading and a quick wash of dark gunmetal, orange glyph light and rose gold. Every sketch shows the whole object in a three quarter view standing on bare sand, each a genuinely different idea, all made by one alien civilisation from pearly opalescent scaled shell, plum cloth printed with a starfield, rose gold trims and dark gunmetal with glowing orange glyph seams. Every one is a case or a set of cases, closed or opening. Not wooden crates, no shelves, no cloth. The twelve ideas: 1 stacked hexagonal cases that unfold like petals into weapon displays. 2 one tall case standing open like a wardrobe with tools held in light. 3 three cubes floating in orbit around each other. 4 a row of cylinder capsules lying side by side with pulsing seams. 5 a case shaped like a beetle shell that opens its wings. 6 nested cases inside each other like a set of boxes, opened out. 7 an upright monolith case with a seam down its middle. 8 a pair of pods fused onto a small hover sled. 9 a clamshell case of dark metal hinged on rose gold. 10 a long reliquary case with a domed lid. 11 slabs of dark metal leaning together like a fan, each a case. 12 a ring shaped case lying flat with a glowing core. Short hand written notes and arrows beside some sketches. Clean white paper, no frame, no other text.
